title: FLEX and Sentinel-3C launch re-watch event on 15 September at ESA's Space Operations Centre
summary: Press Release N° 45–2026 Media representatives are invited to attend the launch re-watch event for the FLEX (Fluorescence Explorer) and Copernicus Sentinel-3C satellites at the European Space Operations Centre (ESA/ESOC) in Darmstadt, Germany, on Tuesday morning, 15 September 2026.
